notes: Drug: Cinacalcet (Sensipar). Class: Calcimimetic (CaSR activator). Formulation: Tablet 30/60/90 mg. Dose (adult): 30 mg PO daily with food, titrate every 2-4 weeks (up to 180 mg/day) by PTH and calcium. Indications: Secondary hyperparathyroidism on dialysis, parathyroid carcinoma, primary hyperparathyroidism when surgery is not possible. Adverse effects: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, paresthesias, hypocalcemia. Contraindications: Hypocalcemia at start. Toxicity / overdose: Severe hypocalcemia (QT prolongation, seizures); CYP2D6 inhibitor; monitor calcium and PTH.
